movie.title: The Love Hypothesis
movie.overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a fake-dating pact between a pragmatic biology PhD candidate and an infamous young professor gets wildly out of hand, both are forced to re-evaluate their strictly scientific theories on love.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Third-year Ph.D. candidate Olive Smith lies to her best friend about having a boyfriend, leading her to impulsively kiss the first man she sees in the lab—who happens to be Dr. Adam Carlsen, the biology department's most tyrannical professor. To Olive's shock, Adam agrees to play along with the fake-relationship scheme to help her resolve her lie while convincing his department that he isn't a flight risk for critical research funding. As they navigate staged dates and forced proximity, their carefully calculated dynamic begins to spark genuine emotional chemistry. Ultimately, they must decide if their connection is merely an unproven hypothesis or a permanent reality.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Olive Smith, a dedicated biology Ph.D. candidate at Stanford, is determined to convince her best friend Anh that she has moved past an ex-boyfriend so Anh can comfortably date him. In a moment of panic to prove she has a thriving love life, Olive impulsively kisses the nearest man in a dimly lit hallway, who turns out to be Dr. Adam Carlsen, a notoriously strict and unyielding young professor. Surprising Olive, Adam agrees to fake-date her to maintain the charade, as he has his own ulterior motive: convincing the university administration that he is settled so they unfreeze his vital research funding. The two establish strict boundaries and ground rules, agreeing to act like a swoon-worthy couple around campus and during departmental events. However, the line between performance and reality quickly blurs as they spend more time together, sharing personal secrets, coffee orders, and moments of surprising vulnerability. Adam proves to be fiercely protective and supportive of Olive's academic ambitions, contrasting sharply with his terrifying public persona. Complications arise during a major scientific conference when Olive's groundbreaking research comes under threat from an unscrupulous colleague. Relying on Adam's unwavering support, Olive finds the courage to speak up for herself and confront the professional challenges in her path. As their mutually beneficial arrangement draws to a close, both Olive and Adam must confront the overwhelming data showing that their fake love has evolved into undeniable truth.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Love Hypothesis follows Olive Smith, a brilliant yet self-deprecating doctoral student in biology who believes that love is an unstable emotion governed by fleeting chemical reactions rather than lasting bonds. When a benevolent lie to her best friend spins out of control, Olive is forced to fabricate an entire relationship on short notice. Enter Dr. Adam Carlsen, Stanford's most feared academic, whose demanding reputation is matched only by his formidable research portfolio. When the pair agree to a mutually advantageous fake relationship, they set off a chain reaction of awkward encounters, high-stakes academic politics, and unexpected romantic tension. As the boundaries of their agreement begin to dissolve, the story explores themes of ambition, mutual respect, and the unexpected ways true connections are formed when scientific logic gives way to the heart.

story_structure.climax: A major professional setback and unexpected betrayal at the academic conference threaten Olive's research career and shatter the precarious boundaries of their arrangement, forcing her to choose between self-preservation and vulnerability.
story_structure.conflict: The man turns out to be Dr. Adam Carlsen, a brilliant but notoriously harsh young professor. To solve mutual problems—Olive convincing her friend, and Adam unfreezing his research funds—they agree to enter into a temporary, mutually beneficial fake relationship.
story_structure.resolution: Olive and Adam confront the truth about their feelings, clear up misunderstandings, and transition their calculated arrangement into an authentic, lasting relationship.
story_structure.introduction: Olive Smith, a third-year Ph.D. candidate at Stanford, panics and fake-kisses the first man she sees in the hallway to convince her best friend that she is over her ex and moving on.
story_structure.risingAction: As Olive and Adam navigate public dates, department gossip, and strict boundaries, their mutual respect grows into genuine attraction. Complications arise when an upcoming academic conference and professional opportunities force them to confront their true feelings alongside career stakes.
